verdict.rationale: New Relic documents a NerdGraph API explorer as an easy way to experiment with its GraphQL API, which amounts to an interactive, runnable API surface. The evidence is a single thin mention, though, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 at every candidate path, so no interactive reference is evidenced beyond NerdGraph. Missing for 10: documented runnable example library within the reference, detail on the explorer's capabilities (schema docs, query building), interactive reference for non-GraphQL APIs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
